result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main visible defect is a promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card displaying '–0%', which is a meaningless discount value likely caused by a missing or zero discount amount being rendered. No other clear visual breakage was found.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '–0%', which is a nonsensical value and looks like a data/rendering bug (a zero or missing discount being formatted as a promo).
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and only render it when a real, non-zero discount exists.
